title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reading.body:
An AI image generation system was used to create sexually explicit synthetic images of a real person without her consent. The person who deployed the system obtained photographs from the victim's private social media accounts and used them as input to generate fake obscene content. The system itself appears to have functioned as designed; the failure was entirely in how a person chose to use it.

The generated images were then distributed through multiple social media platforms and messaging services under fake identities. A person would have caught this use before distribution if anyone had reviewed the person's activities or if the platforms had detected the synthetic sexual imagery during upload. It is not established whether the AI system had safeguards to refuse this type of request, or whether such safeguards would have been effective.

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for creating and distributing sexually explicit AI-generated images of a college acquaintance. Bansal, a BTech graduate in Electronics and Communication Engineering from East Punjabi Bagh, allegedly obtained photographs from the woman's private social media accounts and used artificial intelligence technology to create obscene morphed images and videos. He then circulated this content through multiple fake accounts on Instagram, Discord, and Facebook while using various Gmail addresses to hide his identity.

The victim, also 22 years old, reported the harassment to the Cyber Police Station in North Delhi after receiving anonymous messages informing her that her manipulated photographs and videos were being shared on Discord servers. During the investigation, police analyzed digital footprints and traced the fake profiles to Bansal. He admitted knowing the woman from college and stated that personal resentment had motivated his actions following repeated insults between them. Police recovered a mobile phone, two SIM cards, and other digital evidence during the arrest, with the investigation still ongoing.
title_en: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online
